# Every Indian job,ranked and matched to you. You waste hours scrolling endless portals for jobs that fit. myjobb AI does the AI job matching for you: it reads 50K+ new jobs a day across every major platform and ranks only the roles that match your resume. Get my curated feed, freeHow AI job search works ↓. ## AI job matching that filters 500K+ jobs down to the ones worth your time. Every major job board pushes 50K+ new jobs a day, and a chronological feed just ranks whichever scraper fired last. AI job matching flips that: every posting is read, scored, and gated against your profile before you ever see it. 500K+ scored → 3 worth your time. ### AI job matching reads the flood so you never scroll it. myjobb AI scores every one against your profile and re-runs the whole corpus every day. Hard gates drop the wrong cities, work modes, and experience bands outright, AI job matching scores what survives against your actual resume, and a quality floor cuts everything that doesn't clear it. Most of the best AI job search tools just alert you to more jobs. An AI job search agent exists to delete them, until only the shortlist is left. myjobb AI streams the actual reasoning: which skills matched and at what weight, which hard gates the role passed, what each gap deducted, and how freshness scaled the result. The number on the card is the sum of lines you can read. Scroll the ledger and watch each one light up the part of the job card it scored. Day and night it scores 500K+ live jobs across every major platform against your profile. If "best" means callbacks per hour of your time, it is the AI job search tool that reads the market for you and shows its work. myjobb AI matches you against 500K+ live jobs across every major platform, re-scored around the clock against your resume, and explains every score with a deductions ledger. ### What is an AI job search agent? myjobb AI reads every new posting across every major platform and shows you only the roles that fit, each ranked and explained.

results.content:
Tech, 2+ years: Naukri + Instahyre + Hirist, with an AI agent applying across all three.
 Startup-focused: Cutshort + Wellfound for discovery, LinkedIn for founder outreach.
 Management, 8+ years: iimjobs + LinkedIn. Volume matters less; positioning matters more.
 Fresher: Naukri + Foundit + Internshala for internship-to-job pipelines. Tailored resumes matter most here.
 Frustrated with low responses everywhere: the portal is probably not the problem. Fix resume tailoring and application volume with an AI layer first.

For a wider look at the tools themselves, see our roundup of the best AI job search tools in India for 2026. [...] This distinction matters in the naukri vs ai job tools debate. Switching from Naukri to Instahyre changes where you search. Adding an AI agent changes how you apply everywhere. We break down the full category in our guide to AI job agents vs job boards vs bots.

myjobb is India's first AI job agent, built by Infyn Technologies. Here is what it does on top of the portals: [...] ### Cutshort and Wellfound: for the startup lane

Cutshort uses AI matching plus direct recruiter chat, which kills email back-and-forth. Wellfound lists salary and equity upfront and connects you straight to founders. Both beat Naukri for startup roles at companies like CRED, Zepto, or Meesho.

## Are AI job sites like Naukri alternatives, or something different?

AI job tools are a different category, not another portal. A portal lists jobs and waits. An AI job agent reads jobs across portals, matches them to your resume, tailors your CV, and applies for you.
